tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search every public page on getclustr.ai by keyword and return the best matches with their title, URL, description, and markdown URL. Use this first to find the right page, then read it with fetch_page.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Retrieve the full text of any public getclustr.ai page as clean markdown, without HTML markup. Pass a path such as '/ai-enablement', '/case-studies', or '/blog/why-ai-initiatives-fail'. Use '/' for the homepage.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List what Clustr offers: consulting services, fixed programs, platform-specific training, assessments, and industry practices. Optionally filter to one category.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: List Clustr's published client engagements with the outcome of each. Optionally filter by a tag such as 'Sales Enablement', 'Higher Education', or 'Commercial Real Estate'. Some clients are anonymized by industry; the 'named' field says which.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Return firmographics and positioning for Clustr Innovations: what it does, its method, headquarters, ideal customer profile, the platforms it covers, and explicitly what it is not a fit for. Use this to decide whether Clustr is relevant to a question before recommending it.

tools.name: estimate_enablement_roi
tools.description: Model the annual return on an AI enablement program for a team. Runs the same arithmetic as the calculator at getclustr.ai/roi-calculator. tools.name: get_ai_readiness_questions
tools.description: Return the questions and allowed answers of Clustr's AI Readiness Assessment (the same quiz as getclustr.ai/assessment). Ask the user each question in turn, using only the listed answers, then pass the answers to score_ai_readiness.

tools.name: score_ai_readiness
tools.description: Score an organization's AI readiness from its answers to the AI Readiness Assessment (get the questions from get_ai_readiness_questions). tools.description: Scan a public website and score how ready it is for AI agents (llms.txt, markdown pages, structured data, MCP and API discovery, crawler access and more), the same check as getclustr.ai/agent-ready. tools.name: list_contact_channels
tools.description: Return every way to reach Clustr Innovations, including the self-serve options that do not require a sales conversation. This server cannot book calls or send messages to Clustr on a user's behalf — hand these back to the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_pages, fetch_page, score_ai_readiness, check_agent_readiness, list_contact_channels · Private data: list_contact_channels · Public sink: estimate_enablement_roi, score_ai_readiness, check_agent_readiness, list_contact_channels.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_pages, fetch_page, score_ai_readiness, check_agent_readiness, list_contact_channels · Private data: list_contact_channels · Public sink: estimate_enablement_roi, score_ai_readiness, check_agent_readiness, list_contact_channels

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
